title: Law to require co-op board training by the City
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to create a training program for cooperative apartment boards of directors, covering local, state and federal housing laws relevant to board duties, including anti-discrimination protections, fiduciary duties and best management practices. HPD would have to establish the program within one year of the law taking effect and run an outreach campaign to inform co-op boards that the training is available.
